newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close down on political worries.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close down on political worries.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Tuesday as investors stayed out because of political uncertainty ahead of the February 3 elections, dealers said.
"Bearish sentiment continues because of political uncertainty," Karachi dealer Sameer Ahmed said. "There is no buying interest and the index slipped in low volumes."

The 100-share index ended 17.37 points, or 1.28 percent, down at 1,338.66 amid 121 losers and 51 gainers. The latest fall followed President Farooq Leghari's creation on Monday of a national security council, giving the military a formal advisory role in government affairs. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
